_comment: Two senses. A bed of whatever the phrase names laid over a sea or river floor, like vanilla's sand disks: `clay
beds`, `gravel beds`, and sand when the phrase names nothing. And the furniture, every bed of every colour, for what
grows that takes a block: `beds piles`, `teeming large beds piles`; the default, but never said of the whole Age, which
would build the world of beds, so `beds age` is the ground's.
